description: Darlington New Nuclear Project - Information and Reports is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission | Commission canadienne de sûreté nucléaire. This dataset includes links, documents, document titles and reports which are of importance to Ontario Power Generation (OPG)'s Darlington New Nuclear Project (DNNP). The purpose of this dataset is to proactively share and provide details on all information which is publically available for the project. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission | Commission canadienne de sûreté nucléaire. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
